originalAlarm.description: Undefined or garbage value returned to caller

sanitizedDescription: Undefined or garbage value returned to caller
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (UNDER-CONSTRAINED): e39363a9def.c (Linux netpoll). 'Undefined or garbage value returned to caller' at line 17 ('return err'). Same file as FAMILY_74. When CONFIG_IPV6=false, the '#else' branch at line 13 executes 'goto put' unconditionally, bypassing 'err = -1' at line 9. 'err' is then uninitialized at 'return err' (// ERROR (3)). This is the known vbdb bug. UNDER-CONSTRAINED: presence condition is CONFIG_NETPOLL=true, but the bug requires CONFIG_NETPOLL=true AND NOT CONFIG_IPV6. When CONFIG_IPV6=true, 'err = -1' is assigned at line 9 before any goto, so 'err' is always initialized at the 'put:' label. The presence condition includes CONFIG_IPV6=true cases where the bug cannot manifest. Correct condition: CONFIG_NETPOLL=true AND NOT CONFIG_IPV6.
